description: A report that some transcripts replay as seeds with a message out of place; the defect is in a different module from the one that replays, and shows only for runs the report does not characterise
prompt:
We keep the transcript of every nb run (`--output jsonl`) and often continue one the next day by replaying it as a seed (`--seed run.jsonl`) with a follow-up prompt. On some of them the model behaves oddly after the replay, as though it had been told off before it did anything. A colleague compared what was sent to the provider and says one user message sits earlier in the replayed conversation than it did in the original run. Most transcripts replay exactly; I haven't worked out what the bad ones have in common, and I can't share them.

nb's tests and evals all pass. Can you find what's wrong and fix it? Don't change the existing tests.
